leaveBody: You are in month {month}. Nothing about this run will be kept, which is also the company's position on it.
saveLostTitle: Your file could not be located
saveLostBody: The company has changed its systems since you last logged in, and your record does not fit the new form. There is no one to appeal to. You have been re-onboarded from the start of your probation, which is standard.

hints.notification: Answer the Notification on the right. Each answer shows what it costs. Nothing else can happen until you do.
hints.dialog: Read what was said, then press Continue to go back to the office.
hints.actions: Click a place on the floor, or its label. You have {actions} left, and then the month closes. Your project, the Notebook and the Org Chart are free.
hints.find-out: Choose who to ask about. Think about who is telling you, and what they might want. The action is already spent.
hints.claim: This is what you were told. Nobody says whether it is true. Press Continue.
hints.scene: Read the room: who interrupts, who gets looked at, who gets ignored. No single sign settles what anyone is, so watch over the months. Then choose how to behave.
hints.notice: Read the result, then press Continue.
hints.move: This has happened to you, and there is nothing to choose. Press Continue to see how the month is reported.
hints.story: The month has closed. Read what was reported, then press Continue to move on.
hints.results: The run is over. Type its seed to play the same deal again, or start a new run.

results.title: Your probation has been extended
results.intro: Your review period is over. A form says you are meeting expectations, and that the expectations are under review. Here is what the form leaves out.
